'''Duck soup noodles''' or '''duck leg noodles''' ({{zh|t=鴨腿麵線|s=鸭腿麺线|poj=ah-thuí-mī-suànn}}; also spelt ''ak-twee-mee-sua'') is a style of serving noodles. The dish consists of ingredients such as [[Duck as food|duck]] meat in hot soup with mixed [[herbs]] and noodles.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Jung |first1=Susan |title=Chinese duck noodle soup recipe |url=https://www.scmp.com/cooking/recipe/chinese-duck-soup-noodles/article/3104005 |access-date=25 November 2024 |work=SCMP Cooking {{!}} South China Morning Post |language=en}}</ref>
